content:
BUILT CoLAB will participate in the 9th STRATEGIC FORUM PTPC – CLUSTER AEC, which will be held on December 3rd. This edition of the Forum, totally online, will discuss the theme “Recovery and Resilience Plan – Build the Future”.

The first half of the event will be dedicated to the presentation of the AEC Cluster, addressing topics that are intrinsic to it: the Sectoral Compact for Competitiveness and Internationalization, the BUILT CoLAB Collaborative Laboratory, the DIGITAL CONSTRUCTION REVOLUTION Mobilizer Program, METABUILDING (H2020), and also the SIAC qualification and internationalization. The President of the Order of Architects will also have the opportunity to address the theme “Creating a New Bauhaus to Fulfill the Green Deal”. The second part of this Forum will be dedicated to the “Recovery and Resilience Plan and The AEC Cluster”.

It should be noted that the opening of the event will be in charge of the Presidents of THE COMPETE and IAPMEI, and the closure of the Sec. State of the Economy, also with several other Secretaries of State as well as several representatives of the AEC Sector.

Get to know the program www.ptpc.pt. Registration is free, but limited to 200 participants. Sign up for: evento.ptpc.pt.
